_comment: SEED misuse-shape corpus: test-grade, hand-authored, sufficient for the per-language e2e tests of the misuse lane (overbroad catch, discarded error, blocking and synchronous waits in async functions, fire-and-forget tasks, missing await) and of its local shapes (retry delay, loop-variable query, SQL text built in a call, print-style output, latency metric that is not a histogram). RC-022 (retry), RC-073 (loop-variable query, arbitrated in po-av01j.105) and RC-026 (latency) are the controls the catalog has for those classes. NO control is arbitrated for the other classes yet. RC-029 and RC-019 are stand-ins for these tests only; the production corpus assigns the control.

misuse_shapes.rationale: an error assigned to the blank identifier is a failure nobody sees
Close on a file that was only read has no error worth handling
a catch of the root exception type also handles the failures this code did not expect
a blocking call on the event loop stops every other task until it returns
a synchronous wait on async work holds the thread that must complete it
a task with no owner can be collected before it completes, and its exception is lost
a coroutine that is never awaited does not run
retries with a constant delay, with no random term or with no limit arrive together and keep a failed dependency down
a query on a relation of the loop variable runs one time for each row
SQL text built from a value lets the value change the statement
a printed line has no level and no fields, and the log pipeline cannot filter it
a mean hides the slow requests; a percentile needs a histogram
